title.en: Koottanchoru: Gopallapurathu Makkal (கூட்டாஞ்சோறு: கோபல்லபுரத்து மக்கள்) by Ki. Rajanarayanan

text.en: Villagers welcome hungry strangers with simple food and open hearts.

This is an extract from a novel by Ki. Rajanarayanan. It shows the hospitality of the simple, open-hearted villagers whose natural welcome and plain food make a traveller forget his tiredness. When guests arrive hungry, the villagers share what they have.
The piece shows village life and community feeling, and teaches that hospitality does not depend on wealth.
Terms: கூட்டாஞ்சோறு (food cooked together), கிராமம் (village), விருந்தோம்பல் and கி. ராஜநாராயணன்.
